Anna — great, thanks for the numbers and the sample. I pulled together a concise model shortlist and an initial sizing estimate based on your traffic profile and latency targets. Notes below, plus two quick ops asks at the bottom.

Model shortlist (prioritized):
1) Mistral-Instruct-7B-16k (quantized q4f16) — good instruction-following quality, lowest latency/cost at low context sizes, recommended for the chat flows with <4 turns.
2) Llama-3-70B-8k (int8 + KV cache) — better long-context coherence for multi-turn policy explainers; higher token cost but fewer hallucination regressions.
3) Redstone-32k-deriv (8-bit quantized, trimmed context) — for the 8k+/document flows where retrieval augmentation is used; keep as fallback for long-form explainers.

Sizing assumptions (pilot: 1.8M gen tokens/mo; peak concurrency 1.2k; mean request = 340 tokens including prompt+response):
- Target latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for <=512-token flows; p95 < 1.1s for 2k-token retrieval cases.
- Concurrency plan: provision for 1.5x peak -> 1.8k concurrent requests for safety during pilot.

Estimated footprint (cloud GPU pool — rough):
- Mistral-Instruct-7B-16k: 4x A10-equivalent instances (continuous), autoscale to +2 for spikes.
- Llama-3-70B-8k: 6x A100-equivalent nodes for steady state, with burst headroom (GPU packing recommended).
- Redstone-32k fallback: 2x A100 instances reserved for low-volume long-context tasks.

Cost velocity (hosted estimate, pilot):
- Mistral path: ~$0.38 per 1k tokens served (including batching and cache assumptions)
- Llama-3-70B path: ~$0.75 per 1k tokens
- Mixed routing (default to mistral, use llama for >1k effective context): blended ~$0.45–0.55 per 1k tokens depending on routing ratio.

Operational recommendations:
- Start pilot on Mistral-Instruct for the user-facing chat journeys; enable a realtime fallback to Llama-3-70B for longer threads or flagged coherence failures.
- Enable prefix/KV caching for user sessions to reduce repeated prompt costs.
- Canary: route 10% of traffic to Llama-3 for the policy explainers for 2 weeks, compare quality on the provided prompt set.

Next asks: can you confirm 1) whether the 1.8M token monthly baseline is the one to size for pilot; 2) latency SLOs are flexible if we trade cost for latency in Dedicated?

Attaching: greenfield-mvp-map.xlsx (mapping of flows) and a token estimates CSV.

Diego
